name: Image
signature: public sealed partial class Image : IDisposable

docs.summary: A decoded image and the entry point to the library. The Try members never throw for malformed input; prefer them for files you did not produce. A decoded image owns its pixel memory, which is pooled by default, so a span taken from a frame must not outlive the image.

members.name: FromPixels
members.signature: public static Image FromPixels(ReadOnlySpan<byte> pixels, int width, int height, PixelFormat format, int stride = 0, bool usePooledMemory = true)

docs.summary: Wraps pixels a caller already holds, so they can be written or resized. The bytes are copied, so the source may be reused or freed straight afterwards.

params.pixels: The pixels, top row first unless `stride` says otherwise.
params.stride: Bytes between rows in `pixels`, or zero when the rows are packed.
params.usePooledMemory: Whether the copy is rented from the pool, which is cheaper but has to be returned by [`Dispose`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.Image~Dispose) before the caller lets go of any span taken from it.
